t: WET Code: The Future of AI-Native Development
s: This article introduces WET (Write Explicitly, Terminate) workflows as a paradigm shift for AI-assisted development, proposing a single-source-of-truth approach to overcome LLM context fragmentation and ambiguity. It highlights the synergy of Python, HTMX, and local AI models for transparent, reproducible, and AI-optimized development.
sub: WET vs. DRY in AI Coding Contexts
Python & HTMX as First-Class Web Development Tools
